studies.finding: With saturating 50 micromolar ADP and 10 mM phosphate the vesicles synthesize about 250 +/- 50 nmol ATP per min per mg, with apparent Km values of 11 micromolar for ADP and 104 micromolar for phosphate; cyanide stops synthesis at once and CCCP leaves under 10 percent. studies.finding: All rates measured over a pH difference of -0.3 to 2.2 and a membrane potential of -30 to 140 mV fall on one curve against the proton-motive force, whatever the division between the two terms and whatever the internal potassium concentration between 1 and 50 mM; either term alone drives synthesis, even when the other opposes, and nigericin, which collapses the force, prevents synthesis. Synthesis sets in only above a force of about 100 mV, which agrees with the about 95 mV at which synthesis and hydrolysis balance for a phosphorylation free energy of 37 kJ/mol and the H+/ATP ratio of 3.3 implied by the ten c subunits. At fixed pH difference and potential the rate is independent of the external pH between 7.2 and 8.0 and falls above 8.0, and it drops when the internal pH is lowered to 5.6.
limitations: One reconstituted thermophilic enzyme at 30 degrees C with saturating ADP and phosphate and almost no ATP present; the force is imposed by an acid-base jump and a valinomycin diffusion potential rather than maintained by a pump.
The membrane potential is calculated from the Nernst equation rather than measured, and the calculation fails below 1 mM internal potassium, where other ion fluxes contribute.
Rates are initial rates from exponential fits with no correction for enzymes facing the wrong way, so absolute turnovers are underestimated.
The supplementary figures, including the equilibration and leak controls, were not read.

studies.preparation: Every reconstitution uses the same 10 mg of lipid and 75 micrograms of enzyme, with contaminating potassium washed out of the lipid to about 0.05 mM. ATP is followed by luciferin-luciferase luminescence calibrated with three additions of 0.1 nmol ATP, and the initial rate is taken from an exponential fit of the first 6-15 s. Controls add the H+/K+ antiporter nigericin, change the external and internal pH at constant pH difference and potential, and impose either term alone, including against an opposing contribution of the other.
